concerns.text: Research document describes 8 primary correlation tests (2 coherence metrics × 4 sleep stages), while the plan’s FR‑007 entry claims 30 tests. The differing test counts conflict and break consistency across design artifacts.

Schema hard‑codes Bonferroni factor of 8, but plan’s FR‑007 uses a factor of 30. The plan must align with the contract or the contract must be updated; otherwise the generated analysis_results.json will not validate.
